description: This file defines a PHP interface named 'SuiteEditorInterface' intended for use in SuiteCRM's SuiteEditor component. It specifies methods for setting up editor settings and generating HTML output, and includes licensing and security check code.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures editor settings after object construction, optionally takes a 'SuiteEditorSettings' object or array.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML output for the editor.
